basic_details.scholarship_name: University of Calgary Graduate Research Scholarship & Teaching Assistantship in CS
basic_details.offering_entity: University of Calgary Department of Computer Science & Faculty of Graduate Studies (FGS)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: University of Calgary (Main Campus, Calgary, Alberta, Canada)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Department of Computer Science: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Algorithms and Complexity, Data Science and Analytics, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Information Security and Privacy, Visual Computing, and Systems/Cloud Computing.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~70 to 90 funded graduate research positions awarded annually across thesis-based MSc and PhD intakes
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international merit competition; Pakistani graduate researchers in computing secure ~6 to 12 fully funded positions annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years for MSc (Thesis); up to 4 years for PhD, subject to satisfactory annual academic and research progress

nationality_requirements: Open to Canadian and international students of all nationalities (Pakistan eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No formal age restrictions; evaluated on academic excellence, programming background, and research potential.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) in Computer Science or closely related STEM discipline for MSc; a research Master's degree (18 years education) in Computer Science with thesis for PhD from an HEC-recognized university with strong academic standing (minimum 78% aggregate or CGPA 3.30 / 4.00; competitive admits typically maintain 3.60+ / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Evaluated on Calgary 4.0 GPA scale; equivalent to minimum Grade B+ (3.3/4.0) over the final two years of study.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Substantial background in data structures, algorithms, computer architecture, discrete mathematics, and operating systems.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduating seniors in their final semester can apply conditionally with expected graduation transcripts.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior software development, open-source contributions, or published research papers in IEEE/ACM venues strongly enhance competitive standing.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 7.0 overall (with no sub-score below 6.0) or TOEFL iBT minimum 97 (reading 20, listening 20, speaking 20, writing 20), or PTE Academic minimum 68. Official test scores mandatory.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; instruction and research conducted entirely in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants must secure supervisory agreement from an authorized Computer Science faculty member as part of the admission review.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold concurrent full external government fellowships without university approval.

tuition_fee.details: International tuition fees (~CAD 8,500 to 14,000 / year) are offset by the Faculty of Graduate Studies International Differential Subsidy and departmental awards, with the remainder covered directly from the guaranteed funding package.
tuition_fee.amount: Covered via funding package (~CAD 10,000 / year; ~PKR 2,050,000 / year)

admission_application_fee.details: University of Calgary international application fee of CAD 145 (~USD 106; ~PKR 29,800) paid online via credit card.

accommodation.details: On-campus graduate housing (Crowsnest Hall) or private rental apartments in Calgary (average CAD 800 to 1,200 / month; ~USD 590 to 880 / month) comfortably paid out of the living stipend.

monthly_stipend.details: Guaranteed departmental minimum funding package: MSc Thesis students receive at least CAD 24,000 to 28,000 / year (~CAD 2,000 to 2,333 / month; ~PKR 410,000 to 478,000 / month); PhD students receive at least CAD 27,000 to 34,000 / year (~CAD 2,250 to 2,833 / month; ~PKR 461,000 to 580,000 / month), composed of Graduate Research Assistantships (GRA) and Graduate Teaching Assistantships (GTA).

airfare.details: International airfare between Pakistan and Calgary is self-funded by the student.

visa_fee.details: Canadian Study Permit application fee (CAD 150) and biometrics fee (CAD 85) paid by applicant.

health_insurance.details: Alberta Health Care Insurance Plan (AHCIP) provides 100% free basic provincial healthcare for international students residing in Alberta for 12+ months; supplementary graduate dental/vision insurance (~CAD 600/year) is covered through graduate student union plans.

food_allowance.details: Groceries and living costs in Calgary (lower cost of living than Vancouver or Toronto) are easily managed within the monthly stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Comprehensive access to Taylor Family Digital Library, departmental GPU research clusters, and high-performance computing facilities.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Faculty of Graduate Studies Travel Awards and supervisor research grants provide up to CAD 1,500 to 2,500 for presenting papers at premier conferences.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Up to CAD 2,500 conference travel funding

travel_transit_allowance.details: Calgary Transit U-Pass provides unlimited transit on CTrain light rail and city buses, included directly in standard student registration fees.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single host university (University of Calgary, Alberta)
participating_institutions: University of Calgary - UCalgary Main Campus (Calgary, Alberta, Canada)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: U15 Group of Canadian Research Universities, QS World University Rankings #182 worldwide, top 10 in Canada for Computer Science and Engineering.
available_majors: Data Science and Big Data Analytics
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Online UCalgary application form, official academic transcripts, curriculum vitae, statement of research intent, official IELTS/TOEFL score report, two academic letters of recommendation, and confirmed faculty supervisor endorsement.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Admission to the AI/ML and Information Security research laboratories is highly selective; establishing early contact with faculty members and demonstrating published research or significant GitHub projects is the primary determinant of admission.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Reach out to prospective supervisors between October and December. Send a concise email attaching your CV, academic transcript, and a 1-page summary of how your technical skills match their current NSERC/CFI funded projects.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create an applicant account on UCalgary Student Centre portal, select Computer Science thesis-based program, identify proposed supervisors, and upload digital application documents.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Explore faculty research groups and email prospective supervisors with CV and research interests (October - December).
Step 2: Take IELTS (min 7.0) or TOEFL (min 97) and ensure official electronic score reporting to University of Calgary.
Step 3: Submit online application on UCalgary portal and pay the CAD 145 application fee before the deadline (January 15).
Step 4: Upload unofficial transcripts, CV, and statement of research intent.
Step 5: Academic referees submit confidential appraisal forms via automated institutional links.
Step 6: Prospective supervisors review shortlisted files and conduct online technical interviews (February - March).
Step 7: Departmental Graduate Committee issues formal admission and guaranteed funding offer letters (March - April).
Step 8: Accept the offer, apply for Canadian Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL) and Study Permit via IRCC.
Step 9: Arrive in Calgary in late August for international graduate orientation and commence studies in September.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Track: All admitted thesis-based graduate students automatically receive the guaranteed minimum funding package without separate scholarship application.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees via secure automated links dispatched directly to their institutional email addresses.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of research intent outlining academic background, specific research problems of interest, and reasons for choosing UCalgary Computer Science.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured 1 to 2-page research outline highlighting technical methodologies and alignment with prospective faculty laboratories.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Curriculum vitae detailing education, technical skillsets, research publications, awards, and software projects.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: 30-minute online video interview conducted by the prospective faculty supervisor focusing on technical depth, programming ability, and research drive.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (min 7.0) or TOEFL iBT (min 97) mandatory; GRE is not required for Computer Science at UCalgary.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Degrees and transcripts must be attested by HEC Pakistan and official sealed transcripts sent upon admission offer.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation required for any documents not issued in English.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the UCalgary graduate admissions portal.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Academic Transcripts and Degree Certificates
required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts for all post-secondary education with minimum B+ / 3.3 GPA equivalent.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Scanned color copies of HEC-attested Bachelor's/Master's degrees and semester-by-semester transcripts.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 1 to 2-page essay detailing research interests, background, and alignment with prospective supervisors.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must clearly name 2-3 UCalgary Computer Science faculty members whose research aligns with yours.

required_documents_checklist.specification: IELTS Academic (min 7.0 overall, 6.0 in each subtest) or TOEFL iBT (min 97).
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Request ETS or British Council to send official scores directly to UCalgary (institution code 0813).

required_documents_checklist.specification: Confidential evaluation letters from academic professors who taught or supervised previous research.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Referees must submit from official Pakistani university email addresses.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Detailed academic CV highlighting technical projects, publications, and programming proficiencies.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Include links to open-source code repositories (GitHub) and published papers.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color copy of passport identification page valid for at least 2 years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani passport must have validity through late 2028.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Main intake is Fall semester (September commencement). Applications received by January 15 receive premier funding consideration.

selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Prior research, publications, technical projects, and supervisor match)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of research intent and problem formulation)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 0% (Interview performance factored directly into supervisor endorsement)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Departmental Graduate Admissions Committee and individual faculty principal investigators.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-phase evaluation: academic credential audit followed by faculty supervisor sponsorship and guaranteed funding commitment.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~1,200 to 1,800 international graduate applicants for CS thesis programs
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~70 to 90 fully funded graduate positions awarded annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~6.0% to 8.0% among competitive applicants with supervisor backing
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: CGPA 3.60+ / 4.00 or 80%+ aggregate from leading Pakistani institutions (NUST, FAST, LUMS, GIKI, UET)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates with solid computing fundamentals, strong programming abilities, and at least 1-2 published papers or substantial research thesis outcomes.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of Pakistani top computer science and software engineering programs.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Canada, Iran, China, India, Pakistan, Nigeria, Bangladesh, Turkey.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of fraudulent educational consultancy agencies claiming guaranteed admission or funding packages to UCalgary.
Legitimate applications are processed exclusively through ucalgary.ca.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: UCalgary application fee is CAD 145 paid securely via the official portal; never pay fees to third-party brokers.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: University of Calgary does not partner with recruitment agents for research-based graduate admissions.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Canadian Study Permit and biometric fee: ~CAD 235 (~PKR 48,000).
Initial settling-in expenses upon arrival in Calgary: ~CAD 1,500 (~PKR 307,500).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You can get admitted to thesis MSc without a supervisor. Reality: Computer Science at UCalgary requires a confirmed supervisor before formal admission is granted.

Myth: Canadian healthcare is not provided to international students. Reality: In Alberta, international students on a valid 12-month Study Permit are covered 100% free under the provincial AHCIP health plan.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial portals claim GRE is required; GRE is NOT required for Computer Science at UCalgary.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.00 / 4.00 (Grade B) in graduate coursework throughout the degree program.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time on-campus academic standing and active participation in assigned laboratory research projects.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual Progress Report (APR) reviewed by the supervisory committee and the Graduate Program Director; satisfactory progress required for funding renewal.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Teaching/research assistantships are limited to an average of 12 hours per week during academic terms to prioritize thesis research.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: No mandatory return requirement; graduates are eligible for the Canadian Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP) for up to 3 years.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bond or repayment obligation attached to the funding package.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding discontinued if student withdraws without authorization or is dismissed for academic dishonesty.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing major requires formal re-application and approval by the new academic department.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Funding is guaranteed for the standard program duration (2 years for MSc, 4 years for PhD); extensions are contingent on supervisor grant availability.
